description: This file defines the TailscaleNetwork enum with static methods to determine if an IPv4 address belongs to a Tailscale tailnet and to detect such an IPv4 address on network interfaces.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks whether a given IPv4 address string belongs to a Tailscale tailnet based on specific address patterns.

methods.name: detectTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Iterates through network interface IPv4 addresses to find and return an address that matches Tailscale tailnet criteria.
